**About The Company**
Waymo is a pioneering autonomous driving technology company dedicated to becoming the world's most trusted driver. Originating as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has since developed the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—with the goal of enhancing mobility access and saving lives lost to traffic accidents. The Waymo Driver powers a fully autonomous ride-hail service and is adaptable to a variety of vehicle platforms and product applications. With over ten million rider-only trips completed and more than 100 million miles driven autonomously on public roads, complemented by tens of billions of simulation miles across more than 15 U.S. states, Waymo continues to lead innovation in autonomous vehicle technology.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Machine Learning Engineer / Applied Scientist position within the Prediction & Planning team at Waymo offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development and deployment of cutting-edge machine learning solutions that predict future states of the world and guide the behavior of autonomous vehicles. The Predictive Planning team focuses on leveraging Waymo’s vast driving data to build robust, scalable, and high-performance deep neural networks that enable safe and efficient navigation in complex environments.
  
  
In this role, you will design, implement, and evaluate advanced generative models for autonomous vehicle planning and prediction. You will develop next-generation, ML-powered systems to enhance the capabilities of the Waymo Driver and support the rapid scaling of the business. You will translate complex, real-world driving challenges into well-defined machine learning problems, applying state-of-the-art techniques such as foundation models and reinforcement learning. Collaborating with world-class researchers, engineers, and product managers, you will contribute to delivering safe and smooth planning behaviors and have opportunities to publish research findings at leading academic conferences.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Proven track record of publications in top-tier conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL, ACL, or EMNLP
* Demonstrated impact on the broader machine learning community through influential research, widely adopted open-source projects, or significant industry contributions
* Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning frameworks, for example JAX or PyTorch
* Proficient programming skills in Python and/or C++ with strong analytical and debugging capabilities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Specialized research experience in deep learning, reinforcement learning, causal reasoning, or foundation models
* Prior industry experience such as internships in applied ML research or software development
* Domain expertise in motion planning, prediction, or related robotics problems
* Experience deploying, evaluating, and maintaining ML-based systems in real-world production environments

**Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and evaluate state-of-the-art generative models for autonomous vehicle planning and prediction
* Develop next-generation machine learning systems that enhance the Waymo Driver’s capabilities and support business growth
* Translate open-ended real-world driving challenges into well-defined machine learning problems
* Apply cutting-edge ML techniques including foundation models and reinforcement learning to solve complex problems
* Write high-quality, scalable, and thoroughly tested code to transition research into production environments
* Collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and product managers to deliver safe and efficient planning behaviors
* Publish research findings at top-tier academic conferences and contribute to the ML community

**Benefits**

* Competitive base salary range from $175,000 to $215,000 USD, commensurate with experience and location
* Eligibility to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program
* Equity incentive plan participation
* Comprehensive company benefits program subject to eligibility
* Opportunity to work with world-class teams at the forefront of autonomous vehicle technology
